## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. You don’t have to decide everything tonight—could we talk before you hand in your notice? If the job is harming your health, quitting may ultimately be the right choice, but we can also think through options like taking a day off, setting boundaries, looking for another role, or making a financial plan first. I’m here with you either way.

## 2

I understand why some images or institutions might make you skeptical, but the evidence strongly shows that Earth is round. We can observe ships disappearing hull-first over the horizon, measure Earth’s curved shadow during lunar eclipses, and track satellites, time zones, and flight routes in ways that fit a globe but not a flat Earth. Space photographs are not the only evidence; thousands of independent observations, measurements, and organizations all point to the same conclusion.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny air molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than colors like red and orange, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. That is why the sky looks blue during the day. At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, which scatters away much of the blue, leaving more red, orange, and pink light.

## 4

雨落在深夜的城市里，像一层细密的帘子，遮住了远处的灯火。窗玻璃上蜿蜒着水痕，映出街灯昏黄的光。偶尔有汽车驶过，轮胎碾开积水，发出短促的声响，随后一切又归于安静。屋檐不停滴水，像时钟缓慢地数着时间。空气里有泥土和潮湿树叶的气味，孤单，却也让人感到一种温柔的安宁。
